harness.measures: The database protocol only: write slot, T1 assembled as production ALL assembles it (IngestionWiring: FootprintWiring.admission over JdbcStorageAdmission(readsFootprint = FootprintWiring.readsFootprint(declarations)) with a declared filesystem, so the one statement also reads the footprint and cohort inputs; seeded trust, observation and watermark rows; no participant and no cohort plan, so the cohort pool is read but not required; probed before every scenario, see t1Probe), T1 (admission lock, one-statement snapshot, reservation insert), the fence rows, T2 (reservations FOR UPDATE, inboxes FOR KEY SHARE, message and attachment rows through JdbcMessageRepository.appendVisible so the ledger triggers run, pg_notify, reservations consumed), retention (ExpireInboxes.sweep hard-deleting one expired inbox per sweep) and compaction on its interval. Uploads are an in-memory stub whose fenced PUT is Stored instantly; T_put and the storage backend are qualified separately (ADR-035 §9a).
harness.lockWaitDefinition: lockWait is StorageProtocolMetrics.lockWait as GuardedStorage reports it: the whole admission call (lock wait, snapshot, decision, insert, commit), NOT the pg_advisory_xact_lock wait alone.
